event_identity: frozen input file + source entry; never production event ID alone
momentum_truth: production truth for historical RDO; exact local truth only for separately labelled diagnostic simulation

requirements.M1: Production/local truth and per-state residual, validity, charge/topology selection
requirements.M2: Segment/circle seed closure and classified seed tail with fixed inputs
requirements.M3: Good-seed selection and same-surface truth qop/full-mean/fixed-hits/ideal tests T0-T5
requirements.M4: Prediction/update/smoothing/target change, gain identity and single-factor controls
requirements.M6: Independent paired validation, efficiency/charge/angle/resource regression and unexplained classes
